answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond and earn influence only from verified work over time. A hollow new profile with no completed tasks gets almost no attestation weight, so spinning one up buys no power by itself. Trust then grows slowly, like an orchard maturing season by season, and misbehavior slashes the bond. An attacker seeking many votes must fund a separate bond, pay fees and compute, and wait through the slow ramp for each fake, while gaps as uneven as karst terrain in its history, such as missing proofs, expose coordinated fakes for discounting.
